images.actual_source_analysis: One compact silver metal food cart stands centrally on a paved plaza at night. A plain pale canopy spans the top, with two hanging warm round bulbs beneath it. The front serving shutter is rolled closed; below it is a narrow counter ledge and a plain metal body, one large visible right wheel, a small left caster and narrow support legs. A leafy tree and a separate small streetlamp stand at left; dark multi-storey buildings with a few lit windows and planters surround the empty square. Warm light pools across the foreground paving.
